documents.population: Undergraduate applicants; high schools outside Canada and the U.S. upload transcripts after applying
documents.notes: 'After you apply: Required Documents' page. The personalised list is on the Join U of T portal; this page lists what may be asked. Supplemental applications are programme-specific ('The applicant portals will indicate if you need to submit a supplemental application'); none is drafted.

items.quote: You must provide full documentation (transcripts) for all secondary and post-secondary studies attempted.
Depending on your academic background and the areas you've applied to, you may also need to submit: Self-reported grades form (if applicable) Proof of English language proficiency
items.condition: depending on your academic background and the areas you've applied to

items.quote: Proof of English language proficiency Standardized test results (e.g., SAT, ACT, IB, AP)
items.condition: depending on your academic background and the areas you've applied to

items.quote: If your documents are in a language other than English or French, you will also need to provide notarized translations.
items.condition: your documents are in a language other than English or French
